Pesto Pasta with Blistered Tomatoes

★★★★★4.7 (856)

Homemade pesto in the time the pasta takes to cook, with sweet tomatoes popped in a hot pan.

SMRecipe by Sofia Marchetti · Tested in the Larder kitchen
Jump to recipe

Blistering the tomatoes concentrates their sweetness and gives the dish a smoky edge.

The recipe

Prep5 min
Cook15 min
Total20 min
Serves4

Ingredients 4 servings

For the pasta

Method

  1. Make the pesto

    Blend the basil, pine nuts, Parmesan and oil with a pinch of salt.

    5 min
  2. Cook and toss

    Boil the pasta. Blister the tomatoes in a hot pan, then toss everything with a splash of pasta water.

    12 min
Toast the pine nuts for a deeper flavor.
